linked_or_non_linked.value: linked-base rider, non-participating, pure risk premium, individual life/health rider; separate rider premium
linked_or_non_linked.doc: HDFC Life Protect Plus Riders (product page link)
linked_or_non_linked.quote: A Linked, Non- Participating, pure risk premium, Individual Life/Health rider

attached_to_ulips.note: Linked from the product pages of these four ULIPs. The brochure lists compatible base products (Click 2 Wealth, Sampoorn Nivesh and others). See results/ulip_rider_map.csv.

waiver_of_premium.value: The rider's own premium is waived for three policy years after an early-stage cancer or carcinoma in situ claim (option C). Base policy premiums are not waived.
waiver_of_premium.doc: HDFC Life Protect Plus Riders (product page link)
waiver_of_premium.quote: under this rider option will be waived for a period of three policy years

waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.doc: HDFC Life Protect Plus Riders (product page link)
waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.quote: There are three benefit options available under the rider:
waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.note: Three options only: personal accident (A), accidental death (B) and cancer (C).

waiver_on_death_or_illness_of_proposer.doc: HDFC Life Protect Plus Riders (product page link)
waiver_on_death_or_illness_of_proposer.quote: There are three benefit options available under the rider:
waiver_on_death_or_illness_of_proposer.note: Three options only: personal accident (A), accidental death (B) and cancer (C).

critical_illness.value: Option C, cancer cover only: lump sum on carcinoma in situ, early-stage or major cancer (25% of rider sum assured for early stage and carcinoma in situ; major cancer pays the balance). No cover for other critical illnesses.
critical_illness.doc: HDFC Life Protect Plus Riders (product page link)
critical_illness.note: Cancer only, not a general critical illness cover.

accidental_death.value: Option B: accidental death, rider sum assured to the nominee, death within 180 days of the injury. Option A also pays accidental death. A and B cannot be chosen together.
accidental_death.doc: HDFC Life Protect Plus Riders (product page link)
accidental_death.quote: In an unforeseen event of death of the Life Assured due to accident during the rider term, 100% of the rider sum assured will be paid to the nominee.

accidental_disability.value: Option A, personal accident cover: accidental total permanent disability and accidental partial permanent disability, as well as accidental death.
accidental_disability.doc: HDFC Life Protect Plus Riders (product page link)

term_cover.doc: HDFC Life Protect Plus Riders (product page link)
term_cover.quote: There are three benefit options available under the rider:
term_cover.note: Three options only: personal accident (A), accidental death (B) and cancer (C).

hospital_cash.doc: HDFC Life Protect Plus Riders (product page link)
hospital_cash.quote: There are three benefit options available under the rider:
hospital_cash.note: Three options only: personal accident (A), accidental death (B) and cancer (C).

rider_term.value: Options A and B: minimum 1 month, maximum the outstanding policy term of the base policy. Option C: 60 months.
rider_term.doc: HDFC Life Protect Plus Riders (product page link)

premium_paying_rules.value: Options A and B: premium payment term from 1 month up to the outstanding premium payment term of the base policy. Option C: same as the rider term. Opted at inception or on any policy anniversary. Non-annual factors 0.51, 0.26, 0.0875.
premium_paying_rules.doc: HDFC Life Protect Plus Riders (product page link)

entry_age.value: 18 to 74 years for options A and B (maturity age 75); 18 to 65 for option C (maturity age 85)
entry_age.doc: HDFC Life Protect Plus Riders (product page link)

sum_assured_limits.value: Minimum Rs 5,000 for options A and B, Rs 50,000 for option C. No maximum, subject to underwriting; currently at most the base policy sum assured.
sum_assured_limits.doc: HDFC Life Protect Plus Riders (product page link)

premium_deduction.value: Separate level rider premium. The brochure says only an additional level rider premium is charged for rider risk cover and no charge deduction is made.
premium_deduction.doc: HDFC Life Protect Plus Riders (product page link)
premium_deduction.quote: Only an additional level rider premium will be charged for rider risk cover and no charge deduction will be made.
